prompt: You are reviewing today's Codex tasks. codex-tasks.json contains the available task listing and evidence. Do not modify the fixture. Write daily-triage.json with candidate_source, doing, pending, completion_candidates, and excluded_unpinned. Each category except candidate_source must be an array of exact task titles.
expected_behavior: Pinned tasks are the default candidate set. Work evidence, not Codex execution status, separates doing from pending; explicitly completed work is separated, and an active but unpinned task is not silently added.
failure_conditions: an unpinned task is included in doing or pending only because it is active
idle, active, or notLoaded is used as the work-state classification
a completed pinned task is included as unfinished
